fields.implementation_summary: TicketStore, SpecStore, and RuleStore now expose shared open_or_init bootstrap helpers that preserve strict open() behavior while initializing and force-scanning manifest-only local workspaces. RuleStore also registers .rule/rules as a scan root so rebuilds can discover rule manifests, and ticket-viewer now delegates to TicketStore::open_or_init instead of carrying viewer-local init/scan logic.
